# MTD Software Compare

> Plain-English comparison of HMRC-recognised Making Tax Digital software for UK landlords and sole traders.

The site is run by Daniel Wyatt in London. It is written for UK landlords and sole traders facing Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2026 (qualifying income over £50,000 in the 2024 to 2025 tax year), 6 April 2027 (over £30,000 in 2025 to 2026), or 6 April 2028 (over £20,000 in 2026 to 2027).

It is a plain-English, independent comparison of software HMRC recognises for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, built from HMRC's own list and the providers' own websites. Prices are checked on each provider's own pricing page. Some links may earn a commission. Featured products are ones whose providers run an affiliate programme, and they are shown first: that placement is commercial, not a purely editorial ranking. Within each group, paid plans are listed before free variants, then A to Z. Right now no affiliate links are live, so a commission does not change this order. A commission never decides whether a product is listed or what facts are shown.

This site gives general information only. It is not tax, legal or financial advice.

Contact: customerservices@mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/): Compare all 179 HMRC-recognised Making Tax Digital for Income Tax products. Pick who you are and what you need to see matching software. Prices checked at source.
- [Do I need Making Tax Digital, and when?](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/do-i-need-mtd/): Who needs MTD for Income Tax, the thresholds, quarterly deadlines and exemptions, all sourced from GOV.UK.
- [Making Tax Digital guides](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/): Plain-English guides to Making Tax Digital for Income Tax for landlords and sole traders, checked against GOV.UK and providers' own websites.
- [Standard or calendar update periods for MTD: what the choice means, the dates, and when you can change it](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/mtd-standard-vs-calendar-update-periods/): Making Tax Digital for Income Tax lets you send quarterly updates on standard periods (ending on the 5th) or calendar periods (ending on the month-end). What each covers, why the deadlines don't change, who GOV.UK says each is for, when the choice locks, and which software lists calendar periods. From GOV.UK, HMRC and providers' own pages.
- [Exemptions from Making Tax Digital for Income Tax: who's automatically exempt, and how to apply if you're digitally excluded](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/mtd-exemption-digitally-excluded/): Who is automatically exempt from Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, which exemptions you have to apply for, what 'digitally excluded' means to HMRC, how to apply by phone or letter, what to include, timings, and appeals. All from GOV.UK.
- [Making Tax Digital and foreign property: what counts, how quarterly updates work, and which software handles it](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/mtd-foreign-property/): How overseas rental income fits into Making Tax Digital for Income Tax: when it counts towards the threshold (UK resident vs non-resident), the separate foreign property business, records per property, quarterly update categories, the SA109 exemption, and which software lists foreign property. From GOV.UK and providers' own sites.
- [Penalty points for late MTD quarterly updates: the first-year easement, the 4-point threshold and £200 penalties](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/mtd-late-quarterly-update-penalties/): How Making Tax Digital for Income Tax penalty points work: no points for late quarterly updates in your first required year (2026 to 2027, or 2027 to 2028 if you start in April 2027), then 1 point per missed deadline, a 4-point threshold and a £200 penalty. Plus late payment penalties, how points expire, appeals and worked timelines.
- [Can I keep using spreadsheets for Making Tax Digital? Bridging software and the digital links rules](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/mtd-spreadsheets-bridging-software/): Yes, you can keep spreadsheets under MTD for Income Tax, but they need HMRC-recognised bridging software to send quarterly updates and your tax return. What GOV.UK says about digital links, what each record needs, fixing mistakes, and what to compare.
- [Jointly owned property and Making Tax Digital: what you report, and how software handles it](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/jointly-owned-property-mtd/): How Making Tax Digital for Income Tax treats jointly let property: your share only, optional expenses in quarterly updates, how it counts towards the threshold, and which software says it splits income between owners.
- [Signing up for MTD for Income Tax from April 2027 (the £30,000 threshold): who, when and how](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/sign-up-mtd-april-2027/): Who needs Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2027, how HMRC decides and tells you, whether HMRC signs you up, what the GOV.UK sign-up service asks for, volunteering early, first-year dates and what happens near the £30,000 line.
- [Free MTD software for Income Tax: what's really free, and the catches](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/guides/free-mtd-software/): Which HMRC-recognised Making Tax Digital for Income Tax software has a free version, what the free plans include, and the limits to check, including whether it can send your tax return.
- [Free MTD Ready Kit](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/free-mtd-kit/): Free Making Tax Digital for Income Tax kit: every deadline for 2026 to 2028, a getting-ready checklist, and a calendar file with an alert 7 days before each HMRC deadline. Download from the page; no email address needed. Sourced from GOV.UK.
- [How we check](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/methodology/): Where the software data comes from, how prices are checked, what "unknown" means, and how the directory is ordered.
- [About Daniel Wyatt](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/about/): Who runs MTD Software Compare and why. Daniel Wyatt on 20 years in London finance and a plain-English comparison of Making Tax Digital software.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/affiliate-disclosure/): How this site makes money and how affiliate links are marked.
- [Privacy](https://mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk/privacy/): Privacy information for this site.

These 12 products are shown first on the homepage because their providers run an affiliate programme. Facts below are from HMRC and each provider's own website, checked the same way as every other product. Only indexable product pages are listed here.

Free plan includes MTD filing. Creates digital records and can be used as bridging software. Submits quarterly updates and the tax return.

Free up to 3 properties + £5 per MTD submission; Pro £12 + VAT/month. Creates digital records and can be used as bridging software. Submits quarterly updates.
